name: Lateral Bear Crawl
instructions: Start on all fours with knees hovering just off the ground, back flat.
Step sideways, moving hand and opposite foot together.
Keep the hips low and level — don't let them sway.
Take small, controlled steps for the prescribed distance, then crawl back.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: An intermediate just your bodyweight core exercise for the abs. Lateral Bear Crawl builds the trunk stability that underpins safe movement as you age.
